key_provisions_or_claims: Conclude by 2026 a legally binding instrument prohibiting lethal autonomous weapon systems that function without human control and regulate all other autonomous weapons.
Develop national strategies on responsible AI design, development and use consistent with IHL and human rights law.
Develop multilateral norms for military applications of AI with multistakeholder engagement.
Consider a new global body to mitigate peace and security risks of AI, drawing on IAEA, ICAO and IPCC models.
Agree on a global framework for oversight of data-driven technology including AI in counter-terrorism.
annotation.summary_en: UN Secretary-General's Our Common Agenda Policy Brief 9 sets out recommendations for multilateral peace and security action. Relevant to embodied AI, it calls for a legally binding treaty by 2026 prohibiting lethal autonomous weapons lacking human control, regulation of other autonomous weapons, and norms and possibly a new global body for military AI.
annotation.title_clean: Our Common Agenda Policy Brief 9: A New Agenda for Peace
